{{nihongo|'''Ono Shrine'''|小野神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Ono, {{ill|Ōtsu|Q202907|qid=Q202907}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Shiga|af|Shiga-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Shiga|ar|شيغا (محافظة)|az|Şiqa prefekturası|azb|شیقا اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Shiga|be|Сіга (прэфектура)|bg|Шига|bn|শিগা প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|br|Prefedelezh Shiga|ca|Prefectura de Shiga|cdo|Shiga-gâing|ce|Сига (префектура)|ceb|Shiga-ken|ckb|پارێزگای شیگا|cs|Prefektura Šiga|cy|Shiga (talaith)|da|Shiga-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Shiga|eo|Gubernio Ŝiga|es|Prefectura de Shiga|et|Shiga prefektuur|eu|Shiga (prefektura)|fa|استان شیگا|fi|Shigan prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Shiga|frr|Shiga (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Shiga|gl|Prefectura de Shiga|hak|Shiga-yen|he|שיגה (מחוז)|hr|Shiga (prefektura)|hu|Siga prefektúra|hy|Սիգա (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Shiga|ilo|Prepektura ti Shiga|it|Prefettura di Shiga|ja|滋賀県|jv|Préfèktur Shiga|ka|სიგის პრეფექტურა|ko|시가현|la|Shigaënsis|lt|Šigos prefektūra|lv|Sigas prefektūra|mk|Шига (префектура)|mn|Шига муж|mni|ꯁꯤꯒꯥ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|शिगा प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Shiga|ne|सिगा|nl|Shiga (prefectuur)|no|Shiga (prefektur)|os|Сигæ|pl|Prefektura Shiga|pnb|ضلع شیگا|pt|Shiga|ro|Prefectura Shiga|ru|Сига|sco|Shiga Prefectur|se|Shiga prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Shiga|si|ෂිගා ප්‍රාන්තය|simple|Shiga Prefecture|sk|Šiga (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Шига|su|Préféktur Shiga|sv|Shiga prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Shiga|tg|Устони Шига|th|จังหวัดชิงะ|tl|Prepektura ng Shiga|tr|Shiga|tt|Сига (префектура)|uk|Префектура Сіґа|ur|شیگا پریفیکچر|vi|Shiga|war|Shiga (prefektura)|wuu|滋贺县|zh|滋贺县|zh_classical|滋賀縣|zh_min_nan|Siga-koān|zh_yue|滋賀縣|qid=Q131358}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}. Its former rank was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. The {{ill|Saijin|Q11591100|qid=Q11591100}} is {{ill|Taganetsuki no Ōomi no Mikoto|Q11604425|qid=Q11604425|lt=Kome-mochi-tsuki-ōomi-no-Mikoto}}, ancestor of the {{ill|Ono clan|Q11464141|qid=Q11464141}}, and is said to be the ancestral deity of mochi making in Japan. For that reason, the annual Shitogi Festival receives worshipers from confectionery industries across Japan. The shrine crest is Mitsume. {{nihongo|'''Ono Shrine'''|小野神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

== History ==
This area is the base of the {{ill|Ono clan|Q11464141|qid=Q11464141}}. The founding period is unknown, but it was designated a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}}). In {{ill|1891|Q7837|qid=Q7837}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 24), it was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.
